title: Halting step for memory operations
statement: Let $A$ be a program of memory instructions, let $l_0$ be an initial program location, let $D$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $q_0$ assign an initial state of $D$ to each decider index, and let $ eta$ be a Boolean value. For any input and any configuration $c$ of the compiled machine, if $c$ has state $q$ and the memory-instruction map at $q$ is defined, then the machine halts after one step and its output is the output of $c$ with $ eta$ appended.
